const ll MOD2 = 998244353LL;

int cnt = 0;
ll pw[15];
ll s[15];
ll cnt2, n;
int ans = 0;

    ll res = 0;
    for (int d = 0; d < 7; ++d) {
        ll offset = (val - (ll)fixpre * pw[d]) % MOD2;
